description:
About Our Brand & Products
Le K Body Essentials is a self-care and wellness brand dedicated to helping customers nourish their skin and elevate their daily routines. We specialize in handcrafted body butters, nourishing body oils, magnesium butter, and other luxury self-care essentials made in small batches with quality ingredients.

What Makes Us Different
Our products are created with intention, focusing on skin nourishment, relaxation, and self-care. We use premium ingredients, offer unique fragrances, and prioritize quality over mass production. Every product is handcrafted to provide a luxurious experience while supporting healthy, hydrated skin.

How Affiliates Can Earn
Affiliates earn commissions on qualifying purchases made through their unique referral links. The more customers you refer, the more you can earn while sharing products you genuinely love and believe in.

How to Promote Us
Promote Le K Body Essentials through social media, blogs, email marketing, product reviews, unboxing videos, self-care content, and personal recommendations. Share your unique affiliate link and inspire your audience to embrace self-care with our products.

Other Information
We love partnering with influencers, content creators, wellness advocates, and self-care enthusiasts who align with our brand values. Our affiliate program provides an opportunity to earn income while helping others discover high-quality self-care essentials. Join us and become part of the Le K Body Essentials family, where self-care meets luxury.
payout_period: The first Friday of each month.

8. Prohibited Activities

Affiliates must not engage in fraudulent activities, spam, or misrepresent our products or services.

Sensitive Traffic Sources Policy:

Affiliates must not promote products through the following sensitive traffic sources without prior written approval:

  • Adult content websites or platforms
  • Illegal content or file-sharing sites
  • Sites promoting violence, hate speech, or discrimination
  • Gambling or betting platforms
  • Cryptocurrency or high-risk investment promotions
